description: This Java class 'ExecutionPool' manages thread pools, scheduled executors, and delay-based task execution, including pulse-based delayed tasks, within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ExecutionPool
classes.description: Manages thread pools, scheduled tasks, and delayed pulse tasks within the framework.

classes.name: ExecutionPool.ExecutionPoolThreadFactory
classes.description: Creates daemon threads with specific naming for thread pools.

classes.name: ExecutionPool.ExecutionPoolPulseWorker
classes.description: Worker that processes delayed 'Pulse' tasks from the delay queue.

classes.name: ExecutionPool.Pulse
classes.description: Abstract class representing a delayed, runnable task with expiration time, used for scheduling.

methods.name: getScheduledExecutor
methods.description: Creates and configures a scheduled thread pool executor with optional pre-start and keep-alive settings.

methods.name: getAllFutures
methods.description: Collects results from a collection of Future objects, logging errors if exceptions occur.

methods.name: addPulse
methods.description: Adds a Pulse task to the delay queue for scheduled execution.

methods.name: removePulse
methods.description: Removes a Pulse task from the delay queue.
